subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw maintain this Microsoft-specific tracker, and if so should the committed file or the living PR body be the sole canonical surface?
rationale: The branch creates an ongoing administrative workflow with two competing mutable outputs; repository behavior does not establish which surface should permanently own it.

options.title: Use Existing Reports
options.body: Keep Microsoft triage in GitHub and ClawSweeper report surfaces rather than adding a parallel root-level tracker.

options.title: Canonical Generated File
options.body: Keep only the committed tracker, add package-level generation and check commands, and remove PR-body mutation.

options.title: Canonical Tracking PR
options.body: Keep only the living PR body and remove the committed tracker, generator artifact, and changelog entry.

recommendation.title: Use Existing Reports
recommendation.body: Keep Microsoft triage in GitHub and ClawSweeper report surfaces rather than adding a parallel root-level tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available signal for repository-wide maintainer workflow direction and is explicitly connected to the tracker discussion.
